mettle.feedback.blades.cut_and_run: Cut and Run · swift, swing ready
mettle.perk.blades.bleed.description: Critical blade hits open a wound: 4 damage over 4 s, stacking up to three times.
mettle.perk.blades.cut_and_run.descripti: Every blade kill gives you +20%% speed for 3 s and a fully charged next swing.
mettle.perk.blades.disarm.description: Critical blade hits knock the weapon out of a mob’s hands one time in five.
mettle.perk.blades.duelist.description: Right-click with a sword to parry for 0.4 s: a melee hit caught in it is stopped, the attacker staggers for 1 s, and your next hit is a critical.
mettle.perk.blades.executioner.descripti: A blade hit that leaves a mob below 25%% health kills it outright (bosses and players take +50%% instead). Each execution gives Speed II for 2 s.
mettle.perk.blades.giant_slayer.descript: Your blade hits deal +25%% to ravagers, hoglins, zoglins, endermen, polar bears and wardens.
mettle.perk.blades.light_feet.descriptio: Attacking with a blade no longer breaks your sprint.
mettle.perk.blades.master_strike.descrip: Strike within 0.5 s of blocking or parrying a hit and your counter is a critical that ignores armour.
mettle.perk.blades.master_strike.hint: Taught by a city’s guard, or found in The Verses of the Long Edge.
mettle.perk.blades.measure.description: Swords and spears reach half a block further.
mettle.perk.blades.momentum.description: Each hit on the same foe within 2 s of the last adds +10%% damage, up to +40%%.
mettle.perk.blades.quick_draw.descriptio: Your first blade hit on a mob that isn’t after you deals +%s%%.
mettle.perk.blades.single_combat.descrip: With only one hostile within 8 blocks, you deal 20%% more to it and take 20%% less from it.
mettle.perk.blades.sword_and_board.descr: Blocking a hit with your shield fully charges your next blade swing.
mettle.perk.blades.unbroken.description: Your first blade hit after 5 s without taking damage is always a critical.
mettle.perk.blades.unbroken.hint: Ten down, and not a scratch on you.
mettle.perk.blades.weapon_master.descrip: Switching between a blade and a heavy weapon makes your first full swing with the new one a critical (once every 5 s).
mettle.perk.blades.whirlwind.description: Sneak and swing a blade to spin, hitting everything within 3 blocks for full damage (every 8 s).
mettle.perk.blades.wide_arc.description: Your sword sweeps hit everything around the target for 75%% of your hit.
